issue.title: Glossary lacks the Agents Archive: add agent-archive, update nav-section, nav-item, agent-data-deck, agent-relation-jump-target

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
The Agents Archive epic sase-1jm shipped with its two memory decisions answered "no"
(glossary_archive_term=no, glossary_strand_updates=no), so five glossary strands are now
missing or wrong. Apply these through /sase_memory_write, then run `sase memory init`:

1. NEW glossary:agent-archive (keep the `agent-archive` slug). Define the Archive view (this
   machine's dismissed agents, one of the Agents tab's two views, toggled with `,a`; the
   other is the Inbox), the host-owned `in:archive` query scope (an amber chip; `in:inbox`
   is the other value; at most one top-level term), Archive rows (light rows, not agent
   nodes: day/project/outcome/model banners, container rows `name xN`, `⋮ N more` rows),
   read-only reading (selecting a row hydrates the real decks from the dismissed bundle and
   never writes or revives), and Restore to inbox (the ⏎ chooser's default; the row stays
   in place with a `⌂ restored` chip). Mention Record as the deck that shows archive
   lifecycle/outcome/time-basis facts.
2. glossary:nav-section: drop the Artifacts Agent pane from the Artifacts list (the pane is
   retired behind the artifacts_agent_pane_retired sunset flag; Stitch is now sub-tab 1);
   add the Archive view's nav sections: the one-line ⌂ Inbox pulse and the ◷ Archive list;
   add the Inbox's one-line ◷ Archive shelf docked under the node column.
3. glossary:nav-item: drop "an agent" from the Artifacts entry examples; add Archive rows,
   container rows, collapsed day banners, and `⋮ more` rows as nav items in the Archive.
4. glossary:agent-data-deck: add the fifth RECORD deck (glyph ≡, picker key `r`, slate
   accent) with Lifecycle, Provenance, Relations, and Links cards, for inbox and archived
   agents alike.
5. glossary:agent-relation-jump-target: a dismissed target now opens read-only in the
   Archive with the target selected (epic decision jump_opens_archive=yes); it is no
   longer revived. Restoring stays a deliberate ⏎.

Source of truth: plan:202610/agents_archive_view.md (UX, Record deck, and retire-pane
sections) and the shipped code (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_archive_*.py,
src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/decks/record/). Proposed by sase-1jm.2 (#1, #2), sase-1jm.3
(#1-#3), sase-1jm.4 (#1, #2), sase-1jm.5 (#1, #2), sase-1jm.7 (#1, #2), and sase-1jm.8
(#1, #2); triaged by the sase-1jm land agent.
